statement: The U.S. Military Academy was founded in 1802 at West Point, New York. Its graduates become Army officers.

corroboratingSources.title: Army Officers: How to Become an Officer

statement: The U.S. Naval Academy was founded in 1845 in Annapolis, Maryland. It commissions officers into the Navy and the Marine Corps.

corroboratingSources.title: List of United States Naval Academy alumni

statement: The U.S. Air Force Academy was established in 1954 near Colorado Springs, Colorado. It commissions officers into the Air Force and the Space Force.

corroboratingSources.title: List of United States Air Force Academy alumni

statement: The U.S. Coast Guard Academy is in New London, Connecticut.
The U.S. Merchant Marine Academy is in Kings Point, New York.
Ulysses S. Grant graduated from West Point in 1843.
Robert E. Lee graduated from West Point in 1829, second in his class.
Douglas MacArthur graduated from West Point in 1903.
Dwight D. Eisenhower graduated from West Point in 1915.
George S. Patton graduated from West Point in 1909.
Buzz Aldrin graduated from West Point in 1951. On Apollo 11 he became the second person to walk on the Moon.
Chester Nimitz graduated from the Naval Academy in 1905.
Jimmy Carter graduated from the Naval Academy (class of 1947).
Astronaut Alan Shepard graduated from the Naval Academy (class of 1945).
Jim Lovell graduated from the Naval Academy in 1952.
Lance Sijan graduated from the Air Force Academy in 1965. He was its first graduate to receive the Medal of Honor.
Chesley “Sully” Sullenberger, the pilot who landed US Airways Flight 1549 on the Hudson River, graduated from the Air Force Academy in 1973.
Gregg Popovich, longtime head coach of the San Antonio Spurs, graduated from the Air Force Academy in 1970.
